$comment: TEAM A / PHASE A - THE FROZEN WIRE SHAPE OF A WORKER ANNOUNCING ITSELF.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The fleet registry (qe-central explorer_workers,
qec_022) was designed around heartbeats but no heartbeat route existed and
the explorer never heartbeated, so the registry was EMPTY on the VM, the
queue drainer stayed off, and every dispatch fell back to the single static
slot - two gate collisions in one day (gap G1). This seam crosses two
services that cannot share an interpreter (both ship a top-level app
package), so the payload is frozen HERE as data and each side asserts
against it in its own process:
qe-explorer  app/heartbeat.py                   (produces register + heartbeat)
-> POST /internal/fleet/workers/register
-> POST /internal/fleet/workers/{worker_id}/heartbeat
qe-central   app/routers/fleet.py               (consumes; writes explorer_workers)
qe-central   app/controlplane/scheduling/worker_registry.py (register_worker, heartbeat)
AUTHENTICATION. Both requests carry the per-fleet X-QEC-Token (the /internal
boundary check, M0.5 T-SEC-02) AND the v2 X-QEC-Signature envelope over the
exact request bytes (hmac_auth.sign: key id, timestamp, single-use nonce,
body hash, scope). The SCOPE binds the signature to one worker id, so a
captured heartbeat cannot be replayed as a different worker's.
WORKER IDENTITY (the Team F seam, stated plainly). Under this version the
worker_id is a CLAIM signed with the shared fleet secret: any holder of the
fleet secret can announce any worker id. That is the same trust level as a
completion callback today. A per-worker credential (Team F) replaces
worker_identity=fleet-secret with a per-worker key id in a later schema
version; nothing in this file assumes it.
CHANGING THIS FILE IS A PROTOCOL CHANGE. Bump schema_version, ship the
reader on both sides FIRST, and add the new version beside this one.

unknown_worker.$comment: A heartbeat for a worker id the registry does not hold answers 404. The worker MUST re-register (declaring capacity and affinity) rather than be resurrected with defaults nobody chose - the registry may have been reset under it.

timing.$comment: The worker beats every heartbeat_interval_s as ADVERTISED in the register/heartbeat response (one place: worker_registry.heartbeat_interval_seconds). qe-central judges a worker stale after heartbeat_ttl_s without a beat, retires it (status -> stale, unschedulable) and deletes the row after its retention window.
